propositions: The workflow editor must present both authored YAML/BPMN configuration (editable) and an immutable read-only Effective Policy view derived from built-ins plus project overlays without conflating the two sources.
Project code-review LLM criteria must have non-empty repository-relative applies_to globs at save validation; empty or missing selectors are rejected with remediation guidance.

The Effective Policy panel displays criterion provenance (digest/source, gate, tier, posture, applicability, enabled/disabled state) read-only and never serializes UI interactions back to workflow or project routing.
Snapshot load or validation failures must mark the Effective Policy view unavailable with an actionable, located error and prevent save; packaged defaults are never silently substituted.
Built-in secondary triggers, project DET selector controls, and plan-review authoring retain distinct trigger semantics and are exempt from the project-LLM glob validation rule.
Authored workflow documents round-trip byte-equivalently while Effective Policy rendering changes with policy updates; editor payloads exclude execution trace, debug detail, and secrets.
